# SciSpace

> > SciSpace provides academic manuscript templates and formatting tools for researchers submitting to journals published by Elsevier, Springer, IEEE, Taylor and Francis, and other major publishers.

SciSpace streamlines the academic publishing workflow by offering pre-configured templates for thousands of journals, supporting both LaTeX and MS-Word formats. The platform integrates citation management, plagiarism checking, and formatting assistance to help researchers prepare manuscripts that meet specific journal guidelines from publishers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Journal templates
- Academic manuscript formatting
- Citation management
- LaTeX and MS-Word support
- Publisher guidelines (Elsevier, Springer, IEEE, Taylor and Francis)
- Manuscript submission preparation
- Research paper formatting
- Citation styles and metrics
- Plagiarism detection
- Impact factor tracking
- Scopus integration
- Academic publishing workflow
- International journal publishers
- University press templates
- Scientific writing tools

## Major Publisher Templates

- [Environmental Chemistry Template - CSIRO Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/csiro-publishing/environmental-chemistry/8db52bae9b1d4dcb8395a0b01658ac35): Environmental Chemistry journal template for CSIRO Publishing submissions
- [Marine and Freshwater Research Template - CSIRO Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/csiro-publishing/marine-and-freshwater-research/f8b0ae112ab94e0e8085ddc7aec8bd87): Marine & Freshwater Research template for CSIRO aquatic science journal
- [Journal of Biomedical Optics Template - SPIE](https://scispace.com/formats/spie/journal-of-biomedical-optics/8b799c984508c6bd954384c6a4d0572f): Biomedical Optics journal template for SPIE publication submissions

## Zibeline International Publishing Templates

- [Pakistan Journal of Geology (PJG) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/pakistan-journal-of-geology-pjg/770ccf6def0748baab618459fa372c0b): PJG template for Zibeline Publishing with formatting & plagiarism tools
- [World Languages, Literature and Cultural Studies (WLLCS) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/world-languages-literature-and-cultural-studies-wllcs/99d70c8ce21145a0a03bca941a5554e1): WLLCS template for languages & literature via Zibeline Publishing

## Regional and Specialized Journal Templates

- [Pakistan Journal of Agricultural Sciences Template - Pakistan Association of Advancement in Agricultural Sciences](https://scispace.com/formats/pakistan-association-of-advancement-in-agricultural-sciences/pakistan-journal-of-agricultural-sciences/399e0b9e3a3544fb824be996bb38bbb1): Agricultural Sciences journal template for Pakistan Association quarterly

## Indonesian University Journal Templates

- [J-IKA : Jurnal Ilmu Komunikasi Fakultas Ilmu Komunikasi Universitas BSI Bandung Template - Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika](https://scispace.com/formats/universitas-bina-sarana-informatika/j-ika-jurnal-ilmu-komunikasi-fakultas-ilmu-komunikasi-universitas-bsi-bandung/6a9c38d2ded34b8e82ff55513453521a): J-IKA communication studies journal template for Universitas BSI Bandung
- [Evolusi : Jurnal Sains dan Manajemen Template - Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika](https://scispace.com/formats/universitas-bina-sarana-informatika/evolusi-jurnal-sains-dan-manajemen/590f1e2132c14a06af608c1ab9f137d6): Evolusi science & management journal template for Indonesian university
- [Jurnal Komunikasi Template - Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika](https://scispace.com/formats/universitas-bina-sarana-informatika/jurnal-komunikasi/f174d7ec1f8749749105ec71bb69b6a5): Jurnal Komunikasi template for Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika
- [CAKRAWALA: JURNAL HUMANIORA BINA SARANA INFORMATIKA Template - Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika](https://scispace.com/formats/universitas-bina-sarana-informatika/cakrawala-jurnal-humaniora-bina-sarana-informatika/7f9c68b1619c45f7a7018baeb7981286): CAKRAWALA humanities journal template for Indonesian university submissions
